# EASA kit · 07 — Bill of materials, mass and power budget (generated by `easa_kit.py`)

Ranges are low–high estimates per line (quantity included). Only the sensor limits are read from a datasheet (Honeywell GAPS, [D]); all other lines are [Y] and are replaced by weighing and current measurement in step 9.

| Item | Qty | Mass (g) | Power (W) | Tag | Note |
|:---|---:|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Inductive proximity sensor, line-monitored (GAPS-class) | 4 | 180–240 | 0.00–0.56 | D+K | < 60 g, 12–32 Vdc, < 10 mA [D]; 10 mA × 14 V = 0.14 W [K] |
| Alert unit (logic, self-test, event log, audio driver) | 1 | 100–200 | 0.30–0.80 | Y | no datasheet |
| Annunciator (rear seat) + repeater (front) | 2 | 50–100 | 0.10–0.40 | Y | one legend lit at a time |
| Harness, 22 AWG, fuselage side, connectors | 1 | 60–150 | 0.00–0.00 | Y | route length to be measured (step 2) |
| Sensor brackets on existing lug fittings | 4 | 40–100 | 0.00–0.00 | Y | no new holes if avoidable |
| Circuit breaker 5 A + placard | 1 | 15–25 | 0.00–0.00 | Y | AC 43.13-1B Table 11-3 [D-ag] |
| Voice output into the audio panel (alert only) | 1 | 0–0 | 0.00–0.50 | Y | only while an alert sounds |
| Throttle-knob vibration motor + wiring (alert only) | 1 | 5–20 | 0.00–0.50 | Y | phone-class eccentric-mass motor |
| Take-off gate: solenoid detent + bracket (alert only) | 1 | 80–150 | 0.00–5.00 | Y | energised only on the ground with the canopy not locked; unpowered = free |

**Totals [K]:** mass 530–985 g; power 0.40–7.76 W with every alert-only item running, 1.76 W continuous.

**Against R-10 (≤ 1000 g, ≤ 2 W):** mass met; continuous power met.
The sensing part alone (sensors, unit, lamps, harness, brackets, breaker) is the 0.45–0.8 kg of the first kit version; the throttle shaker and the take-off gate (5 Nov, official task) add 85–170 g. The alert unit, the harness and the gate solenoid decide the total: weigh a harness mock-up and a candidate solenoid during the survey (step 2). Items marked *alert only* draw power only while an alert is active, so R-10 counts continuous power.
